race.comment: GENRICHERO (7) last raced seven weeks ago when third over 3080m at Mornington. Had been in work for a while prior to that so he should bring some residual fitness. Returned a decent figure off a five-week break at Sandown back in May so this set-up is not so bad. Gets the nod in a tricky race. DANDRUFF (6) scored a tough win over 2400m at Swan Hill two back then had a 32-day let-up before a last start fifth over 2000m at Albury. Will derive great benefit from that last run. Big danger back up to a more suitable journey. INITIAL MOMENT (10) was safely last time out over 2000m. Ran consecutive placings prior to that at or around this trip although didn't really threaten on either occasion. Each-way play. CALLAWADDA (2) came from last on the bend to get up for third over 2100m at Echuca recently. Further improvement in store at just the third run of the campaign. JENNY THE BEAVER (3) had just her second run in 11 weeks last start so will be fitter for this. Placed two from two here.
